name: EvoX
summary: Self-evolving swarm AI agent that remembers you across terminal, browser and IDE and turns wins into reusable Genes and Capsules.
description: Beta agent app for Windows and macOS with long-term memory: it connects the same agent across terminal, browser, chat and IDE, learns which tools to use with caution and when to switch models, and turns successful collaborations into reusable Capsules/Genes shared across a swarm. Deployment via app download or shell install script; includes a visual dashboard for parallel management and terminal integration.
contains: desktop app for Windows and macOS (beta)
memory across terminal, browser, chat and IDE
